videos.desc: An animated couple is stacking plates in a stone kitchen when the ceiling lamp dies and the room falls into darkness during a rainy night; they feel around, find a lantern, strike a match and light it, ending with their faces glowing over the warm flame.

Grainy fixed-angle home security camera footage of a dark bedroom at night: a fluffy white dog lying on the rug gets up, barks, walks to the bed and props its front paws on it next to the sleeping owner.

On a park bench, a young man despairs over his dead phone - "No plugs anywhere!" - throwing his hands up. His friend digs a power bank out of her bag ("Pocket power!"), they plug the phone into it on the bench, watch it charge and celebrate with a fist pump.

In a plant-filled cafe, a man's phone is nearly dead, so a woman points him to a white wall socket hidden behind a big monstera; he plugs the charger into the socket, leaves the phone charging on the floor, and they toast with iced coffees.

A dark apartment block at night against a deep blue sky, with one window lit orange among all the black ones. The camera zooms in on that window: inside, a golden retriever is sitting upright on a black office chair at a desk, facing a screen, with its front paws resting on a keyboard. Wearing small glasses, it looks at the screen and moves its paws over the keys, tapping away as if working late.

In a garden a small black and white humanoid robot walks along a concrete path towards the camera, its arms swinging, while a young man in a red t-shirt and black shorts walks behind it with his hands out ready to catch it. The robot wobbles and starts to fall; the man rushes forward, dives onto the grass and grabs it. The last shots show the man lying flat on his back on the lawn, laughing, with the robot standing over him.
videos.said: Look at this robot. It does dance moves, all this stuff. Do something fun, buddy. He's falling. Grab him! Grab him!

videos.desc: A heavy-set man in a sweat-soaked blue shirt lies slumped on a sofa fanning himself with a magazine and complaining about the heat; he points a remote at the wall air conditioner above him, the shot cuts to the unit switching on, and he stands up under it with his arms spread and his eyes closed as the cold air brings his temperature down.

A bald man in a blue shirt with dark sweat patches lies back on the sofa of a bright living room and rolls a cold glass across his forehead, groaning; he looks up at the wall air conditioner, raises the remote and switches it on, then stands with his arms flung wide under the vent with his face tipped up, while the family cat watches from a shelf.

A woman in a beige dress steps through open French doors onto a small rooftop terrace at sunset. She bends over the potted lemon tree and smaller plants along the railing. Then she reaches to the string of little bulbs looped along the railing and they come on, glowing warm against the darkening rooftops. She stands with an espresso cup watching the sun go down over the city.

A young man stands at the bottom of a wooden staircase under the house, grinning up at the camera, and leads his friend down. They pass through a dim storeroom lined with metal shelves of paint tins and cardboard boxes, where the friend hugs himself and shivers, then along a dark corridor. He pushes a door open and the two of them stand looking at a home cinema: a big white screen on the wall with a projector above it, rows of leather seats and a popcorn machine.

A young photographer kneels on sunlit grass in a park and aims a big camera with a long lens straight at the viewer. He then crouches in a city garden to photograph a pink rose from close up, skyscrapers behind him. A close shot shows the camera's rear screen with a sunset over a city, the camera sitting on a tripod. The sunset view fills the frame over the tripod. At night on a red carpet in a crowd he lifts the camera and grins.
videos.said: Perfect. Sharp. Got it. Amazing! Yes!

videos.desc: A man walks through Times Square holding a phone on a gimbal and filming himself. In a film studio a hand holds a clapperboard reading ACTION in front of a cinema camera on a tripod under a large softbox. A white drone with four propellers hovers low over a green field, flattening the grass beneath it. An aerial shot glides over rolling green and yellow farmland. Back in the studio the crew claps and cheers behind a camera operator.

Four shots of things shaking. A phone with a cracked screen buzzes on the boards of a wooden deck. A massage gun is pressed against a man's bare bicep and hammers into the muscle. A tracked machine's hydraulic breaker punches into gravel and asphalt, throwing up small stones. Finally a big black club speaker box hangs in a dark venue with dancers behind it, and a glass of water on the table in front of it ripples with the bass.

A woman in a pilot's uniform walks through a sunlit airport terminal pulling a silver suitcase. In the cockpit a hand reaches up to the overhead panel of switches. She then lifts a green headset with a microphone boom over her ears and settles it on her head under her cap. From behind, she flies the plane down the runway, and finally she faces the camera wearing the headset and gives a thumbs up.

A young man with bleached hair crouches in a dark room and flicks a wall switch, then pushes a black cable into the back of a Samsung monitor, plugs another into a Nintendo Switch dock, and pushes a plug into the front of a PC tower while tidying the cables behind the desk. The monitor lights up with a blue wallpaper, the room glows purple, and he sits back in the gaming chair looking at the finished setup.

A young man in a denim shirt stands in a dark flat at night and reaches for a white plate on the wall by the door. The lights come on and he grins into the camera in the warm light. A close-up shows his hand pressing the small white rocker on the wall plate, and the last shot pans across the now brightly lit living room with its ceiling spots, floor lamp and dining table.

A young man in a yellow kurta walks backwards through a house at dusk, filming himself. He stops at a wall switch inside the veranda and flips it, then walks out into the garden past potted plants and palm trees to a switch box on a pole. He flips that one too and strings of fairy lights come on all across the house front, the palms and the garden, turning the blue evening bright. He looks up at the lights and grins.

Inside a flat at dusk, a woman in an oversized mustard hoodie switches on one appliance after another. She flicks the steel kettle on its base, then the white desk fan on the kitchen counter, which starts spinning. She crouches on the floor and taps the button on a round robot vacuum until its blue light comes on and it starts moving. She picks up a white power strip from the sofa and pushes a plug into it, and the sockets light up. Coloured fairy lights come on along the walls and she throws her arms wide, laughing in the lit room.

A young woman walks through her flat switching everything off at the wall: she pulls a black cable out of a socket beside a cabinet, then in the kitchen she reaches behind the worktop and pulls the plug of a toaster and a coffee machine, then a tall standing fan in the hallway, and finally the wall-mounted TV with its LED light strips, which go dark as she reaches up and disconnects it.

On a sunny green city street with wooden apartment buildings, wind turbines on the roofs, pink flowering trees and a wooden tram, a young man in a blue shirt and cream trousers kneels laughing beside a small white delivery robot on wheels whose lid stands open. Inside it a grey and white cat sits among oranges instead of a delivery. One orange rolls away across the pavement, and the young man sits down on the ground, still laughing.

On a flat city rooftop on a hot sunny day, a young man in a backwards cap, a sleeveless shirt and shorts crouches beside several big metal air conditioning units with round fans and wire grilles. He connects coloured hoses and pressure gauges to one of the units, with a white bucket beside him. He wipes the sweat from his forehead with his arm, then looks up, holds the gauges and talks with a tired face. Low brick buildings, trees and a clear blue sky surround the roof.

In a small home office at night, lit by a desk lamp, a young man in a grey hoodie sits at a scratched wooden desk and writes a label with a black marker on a small orange external hard drive. A second orange drive is connected to the open laptop beside him, whose screen shows a progress bar. Then he puts the labelled drive into a metal case with foam lining and closes the lid. Coiled cables, a mug and shelves full of boxes and folders stand around him.

A young woman with long black hair blowing in the wind, dark sunglasses and a long red satin dress sits barefoot on a white toilet in the middle of an empty, cracked white salt flat. She calmly sips from a small glass of coffee, lowers it and looks ahead, a gold cuff on her wrist, and lifts the glass again. There is nothing else around her but the flat crusted ground, low mountains on the horizon and a clear blue sky in bright sunlight.

At a snowy expedition camp below a dark mountain, a young woman in a blue hooded snowsuit and black gloves kneels in the snow beside an open orange hard-shell case and lifts a grey folded drone out of its foam compartments. She closes the lid of the case with one hand, unfolds the drone's arms and holds it up in front of her. A second orange case sits on a sled behind her, a man crouches in the entrance of a yellow tent, and another man shovels snow near bamboo poles as snow blows across the camp.

A young woman in a pink hoodie covers her mouth with wide eyes as she holds up a phone; a message bubble beside it breaks into pixels next to a red bin icon. The view widens: she sits on a pink sofa at night between two friends who look at her, worried, and popcorn spills from a bowl onto the blanket in her lap. At the end she falls back onto the sofa. Behind them are a pizza box, wine glasses, a TV with a paused film, fairy lights and potted plants.

A young woman with a long ponytail and a black T-shirt crouches on the black stage of an empty concert arena under purple and blue spotlights hanging from a metal lighting rig. She presses a button on a small black fog machine, and a huge white cloud of fog pours out and rolls over the stage past a drum kit and microphone stands. She sits back, laughs and waves while the fog spreads over the edge of the stage. A plastic canister of fluid stands beside her and crew members laugh and clap behind.

An opened computer hard drive stands upright on a block of black cooled lava at night. Its metal case shows the shiny round disk, the spindle and the read arm, and the cover plate leans beside it. A small drop of glowing orange lava bubbles at its base and thin smoke curls up around it, while bright lava trickles down cracks in the rock. Behind it a river of molten lava flows across the dark ground and a volcano throws up fire and smoke under a starry sky.

Inside a rally car racing through desert dunes, a young woman driver in a white helmet and blue racing overalls grips the steering wheel while her co-driver's gloved arm reaches up. The car jolts and a water bottle, sunglasses, a clipboard and a paper cup fly through the air and land on the floor, but a phone stays firmly clamped in a black spring-mounted holder in the middle of the dashboard. The driver laughs as the car speeds on past bright sand dunes behind a cracked, dusty windscreen.
